swap_risks: CRITICAL SUPPLY VOLTAGE RATING: OPA2333AIDR is limited to 5.5 V max (7 V abs max, p.5) whereas MC33202DR2G supports up to 12 V (13 V abs max, p.3). Installing a 5.5 V CMOS op-amp on a 12 V–24 V rail causes instant breakdown.

CAUTION BANDWIDTH & PHASE MARGIN: GBWP differs by 6.3x (MC33202DR2G: 2.2 MHz p.4 vs OPA2333AIDR: 0.35 MHz p.7); higher-bandwidth replacements can oscillate with capacitive loads or stray feedback capacitance without an isolation resistor.
CAUTION SLEW RATE DIFFERENCE: Slew rate differs by 6.3x (MC33202DR2G: 1 V/µs p.4 vs OPA2333AIDR: 0.16 V/µs p.7); check full-power bandwidth SR / (2π·Vpeak).
CAUTION PRECISION OFFSET SHIFT: Maximum Vos differs by 800x (MC33202DR2G: 8 mV p.3 vs OPA2333AIDR: 0.01 mV p.7); high-gain DC sensor stages may lose accuracy or require zero-drift chopper filtering.
CAUTION THERMAL MARGIN: Package θJA differs by 35% (MC33202DR2G: 190 °C/W p.5 vs OPA2333AIDR: 124 °C/W p.6); re-check Tj = Ta + Pd × θJA against Tj,max.
engineering_verdict: MC33202DR2G (onsemi, SOIC-8) and OPA2333AIDR (Texas Instruments, SOIC-8) are Level 2 Functional / Tuning Required replacements: while the footprint is physically compatible, engineering review and passive/circuit adjustments are mandatory due to supply voltage Vs,max drops >20%; GBWP differs >= 3x; slew rate differs >= 3x. Key datasheet deltas: device type is opamp (push-pull) vs opamp (push-pull), supply limit is 12 V (p.1) vs 5.5 V (p.5), max Vos is 8 mV (p.3) vs 0.01 mV (p.7), input bias current is 80000 pA (p.3) vs 70 pA (p.7), and Iq/ch is 900 µA (p.4) vs 17 µA (p.7). Always validate pinout orientation (TOP_VIEW p.2 vs TOP_VIEW p.4), thermal margin (θJA 190 vs 124 °C/W), and official manufacturer datasheets on hardware prototypes before production release.
